coverage: Engine Preview session-routing opt-in builds with Windows session coordinator and fixed command queue
default launcher remains user-space and source-only
normal Hello/Ack, volume, status, physical catalog and IR regression path
six-route status payload remains backward-compatible for existing routes
explicit opt-in binds default render IAudioSessionManager2
bounded SessionCatalogSnapshot response contains 2 local entries
per-App delivery is explicitly reported unverified
system volume and session routing opt-ins coexist
Windows volume broker reports Ready and session catalog reports Ready
status-only path sends no volume or App command
C# ViewModel receives non-empty catalog and sequence
probe sends no App volume or route write
Expert App/session panel compiles and launches without Windows App Runtime

limitations: Session routing is opt-in and currently binds the default physical render endpoint in user-space; it is not the Hibiki virtual WaveRT endpoint.
App volume commands can target Windows session COM objects only after handle/sequence validation; physical per-App capture/re-send and DSP lane delivery remain unverified.
Process-loopback and Chrome/Edge tabCapture are separate boundaries and are not silently enabled by this preview.
The local machine is Windows 22631/Visual Studio 17 with SDK 26100, below the locked Windows 11 24H2/VS 2026/WDK target.
All build outputs remain under ignored .local paths and are not GitHub artifacts.
